title: hoshidicts el test dictionary
author: hoshidicts
description: A tiny Modern Greek dictionary for languages/el/tests/lookup.tsv, written for the pack. Most of its nouns and adjectives carry the part-of-speech tags n and adj; άλλος and άλλο have none, as in wty-el-en, so lookup.tsv's άλλον row needs lookup.untaggedTerms pass; άθελα is there to come after θέλω for 'θελα. Its function words have none. Its form-of rows are written as wiktionary-to-yomitan writes them, with two of wty-el-en's traps: the strong pronouns' references to τα, and the plural article's reference to η, whose only row is the letter.
